questions.question: What is Harrison Ford’s character called in American Graffiti?
questions.note: Ford plays the swaggering racer who challenges John Milner in George Lucas’s 1973 hit.

questions.question: In The Conversation, what is Harrison Ford’s character named?
questions.note: Stett works for the client whose conversation is being secretly recorded.

questions.question: In American Graffiti, Ford’s Bob Falfa challenges which hot-rodder to a race?
questions.note: Falfa races John Milner in the closing stretch of George Lucas’s 1973 film.

questions.question: Which comic actor plays Rabbi Avram Belinski opposite Ford in The Frisco Kid?
questions.note: Wilder’s Polish rabbi crosses the American West with Ford’s cowboy outlaw, Tommy Lillard.

questions.question: In Hanover Street, Harrison Ford plays an American pilot during which war?
questions.note: Ford plays bomber pilot David Halloran in the 1979 romantic drama.

questions.question: Which Happy Days star plays a Vietnam veteran opposite Harrison Ford in Heroes?
questions.note: Winkler plays veteran Jack Dunne, while Ford plays his fellow serviceman Ken Boyd.

questions.question: Journey to Shiloh, one of Ford’s early films, takes place during which conflict?
questions.note: The 1968 film follows young Texans heading toward the Battle of Shiloh.

questions.question: In Apocalypse Now, Ford’s Colonel Lucas helps brief Willard to assassinate which rogue officer?
questions.note: Lucas appears in the briefing-room scene that sends Willard after Marlon Brando’s Colonel Kurtz.

questions.question: Which actor co-stars with Ford as Major Mallory in Force 10 from Navarone?
questions.note: Shaw reprises the Mallory role from The Guns of Navarone, with Ford leading the Force 10 unit.

questions.question: Which actor stars as surveillance expert Harry Caul in The Conversation?
questions.note: Hackman leads Coppola’s 1974 paranoia thriller. Ford has a small role as Martin Stett.
